title: Interior and body rattle noises
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on rattling or squeaking noises from several vehicle areas, especially interior trim, seats, roofliner, console, doors, and some exterior body parts.

positive.summary: One positive review says the vehicle had no rattles.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe persistent rattling from the passenger seat, roof or headliner, doors or window area, dashboard speaker, rear bumper, and other loose trim or body parts while driving or over bumps.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews mention rattling or tapping noises but also include either a successful dealer fix or language that softens the severity.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews report the onset or location of a rattle, such as the phone charging tray, right rear wheel area, or a noise beginning weeks after delivery, without clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: The topic groups several different noise sources across interior, wheel-area, and exterior/body locations rather than one clearly coherent component issue.
Some example fragments are brief or incomplete, so the exact cause, severity, or repair outcome is not always clear.
Only selected sample fragments are provided, so these examples should not be treated as representative of all G60 vehicles or all occurrences of this topic.
